name: GENERIC_FAILURE
message: The phone could not send the SMS, and Android gave no exact reason. Check the signal and the SMS credit on the SIM, then send the message again.

name: RADIO_OFF
message: The mobile radio on the phone is off, for example in airplane mode. Turn off airplane mode and turn on mobile service, then send the message again.

name: NULL_PDU
message: Android could not build an SMS from this message. Check that the message is not empty, or send a shorter message.

name: NO_SERVICE
message: The phone has no mobile service. Move the phone to a place with coverage or check the SIM, then send the message again.

name: LIMIT_EXCEEDED
message: Android stopped the send because the app sent too many SMS in a short time. Increase the Send Delay in the app or wait a few minutes, then send the message again.

name: FDN_CHECK_FAILURE
message: The SIM has Fixed Dialing Numbers (FDN) turned on, and this number is not on the allowed list. Turn off FDN in the phone call settings or add the number, then send the message again.

name: SHORT_CODE_CANCELLED
message: The phone asked whether textbee may text this short code, and nobody allowed it, for example someone tapped Cancel. Send the message again and tap Send on the phone. To stop the prompt, tick Remember my choice, or set textbee to Always allow in Android settings, Special app access > Premium SMS access.

name: SHORT_CODE_NEVER_ALLOWED
message: textbee is set to Never allow in Premium SMS access, so the phone blocks texts to short codes. In Android settings, open Special app access > Premium SMS access and set textbee to Always allow.

name: RADIO_NOT_AVAILABLE
message: The mobile radio on the phone was not available, for example while it restarted. Wait a moment, then send the message again.

name: NETWORK_REJECT
message: The mobile network rejected the SMS. Check that the SIM has SMS credit and can text this number.

name: INVALID_ARGUMENTS
message: Android rejected the send request as not valid. Check the recipient number and the message text.

name: INVALID_STATE
message: The SMS service on the phone was in a state that cannot send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: NO_MEMORY
message: The phone ran out of memory during the send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: INVALID_SMS_FORMAT
message: Android reported that the SMS format is not valid. Check the recipient number, or send a shorter message.

name: SYSTEM_ERROR
message: Android reported a system error during the send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: MODEM_ERROR
message: The modem on the phone reported an error during the send. Check the signal and the SIM, or restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: NETWORK_ERROR
message: A network error stopped the send. Check the signal, then send the message again.

name: ENCODING_ERROR
message: Android could not encode the message text. Remove unusual characters, or send a shorter message.

name: INVALID_SMSC_ADDRESS
message: The SMS center number (SMSC) on the SIM is not valid. Get the correct SMS center number from the carrier and set it on the phone.

name: OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED
message: Android or the SIM does not allow this send. Check that the SIM can send SMS.

name: INTERNAL_ERROR
message: Android reported an internal error during the send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: NO_RESOURCES
message: The phone did not have the resources to send at that moment. Wait a moment, then send the message again.

name: CANCELLED
message: Android cancelled the send. Send the message again.

name: REQUEST_NOT_SUPPORTED
message: The phone or the SIM does not support this send request. Use a different SIM or phone.

name: NO_BLUETOOTH_SERVICE
message: Android tried to send through a Bluetooth link, and the Bluetooth service was not available. Turn off Bluetooth on the phone, then send the message again.

name: INVALID_BLUETOOTH_ADDRESS
message: Android tried to send through a Bluetooth link, and the Bluetooth device address was not valid. Turn off Bluetooth on the phone, then send the message again.

name: BLUETOOTH_DISCONNECTED
message: Android tried to send through a Bluetooth link, and the link disconnected. Turn off Bluetooth on the phone, then send the message again.

name: CONFIRMATION_DENIED
message: The phone asked for permission to send, for a short code or for many texts in a short time, and the request was denied. Allow the send when the phone asks, or set textbee to Always allow in Special app access > Premium SMS access.

name: BLOCKED_DURING_EMERGENCY
message: Android blocks SMS during an emergency call. Send the message again after the call ends.

name: SEND_RETRY_FAILED
message: Android sent the SMS again after a failure, and that try also failed. Check the signal, then send the message again.

name: REMOTE_EXCEPTION
message: An Android system service failed during the send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: NO_DEFAULT_SMS_APP
message: Android needs a default SMS app on this phone, and none is set. Set a default SMS app in Android settings, then send the message again.

name: USER_NOT_ALLOWED
message: The Android user profile that runs textbee is not linked to this SIM. Run textbee in the main user profile of the phone.

name: RIL_RADIO_NOT_AVAILABLE
message: The mobile radio did not start, or it was restarting. Wait a moment, then send the message again.

name: RIL_SMS_SEND_FAIL_RETRY
message: The mobile radio could not send the SMS. Check the signal, then send the message again.

name: RIL_NETWORK_REJECT
message: The mobile network rejected the SMS. Check that the SIM has SMS credit and can text this number.

name: RIL_INVALID_STATE
message: The mobile radio was in a state that cannot send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_INVALID_ARGUMENTS
message: The mobile radio rejected the send request as not valid. Check the recipient number and the message text.

name: RIL_NO_MEMORY
message: The mobile radio did not have enough memory to send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_REQUEST_RATE_LIMITED
message: The mobile radio refused the send because sends came too often. Increase the Send Delay in the app, then send the message again.

name: RIL_INVALID_SMS_FORMAT
message: The mobile radio reported that the SMS format is not valid. Check the recipient number, or send a shorter message.

name: RIL_SYSTEM_ERR
message: The mobile radio reported a system error. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_ENCODING_ERR
message: The mobile radio could not encode the message text. Remove unusual characters, or send a shorter message.

name: RIL_INVALID_SMSC_ADDRESS
message: The SMS center number (SMSC) on the SIM is not valid. Get the correct SMS center number from the carrier and set it on the phone.

name: RIL_MODEM_ERR
message: The modem on the phone gave an unexpected response. Check the signal and the SIM, or restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_NETWORK_ERR
message: The mobile network returned an error. Check the signal and the SMS credit on the SIM, then send the message again.

name: RIL_INTERNAL_ERR
message: The modem had an unexpected error. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_REQUEST_NOT_SUPPORTED
message: The mobile radio does not support this send request. Use a different SIM or phone.

name: RIL_INVALID_MODEM_STATE
message: The modem was in a state that cannot send. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_NETWORK_NOT_READY
message: The mobile network was not ready. Wait for a stable signal, then send the message again.

name: RIL_OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED
message: The mobile radio does not allow this send. Check that the SIM can send SMS.

name: RIL_NO_RESOURCES
message: The mobile radio did not have the resources to send at that moment. Wait a moment, then send the message again.

name: RIL_CANCELLED
message: The mobile radio cancelled the send. Send the message again.

name: RIL_SIM_ABSENT
message: The phone could not find the SIM. Check that the SIM is in the phone and active.

name: RIL_SMS_DURING_CALL_NOT_ALLOWED
message: The network does not allow SMS during a voice call. Send the message again after the call ends.

name: RIL_ACCESS_BARRED
message: The mobile network does not let this SIM send. Ask the carrier to check the SMS service on the SIM.

name: RIL_BLOCKED_DUE_TO_CALL
message: The network blocked the SMS because of a call in progress. Send the message again after the call ends.

name: RIL_GENERIC_ERROR
message: The mobile radio reported an error, with no exact reason. Check the signal and the SMS credit on the SIM, then send the message again.

name: RIL_INVALID_RESPONSE
message: The mobile radio got a response it did not recognize. Restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_SIM_PIN2
message: The SIM needs its PIN2 code for this send. Enter PIN2 on the phone, or turn off Fixed Dialing Numbers (FDN).

name: RIL_SIM_PUK2
message: The PIN2 code of the SIM is locked. Get the PUK2 code from the carrier and unlock it.

name: RIL_SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_AVAILABLE
message: The phone could not find the subscription of the SIM. Check that the SIM is active.

name: RIL_SIM_ERROR
message: The SIM card returned an error. Take out the SIM and put it back, or restart the phone, then send the message again.

name: RIL_INVALID_SIM_STATE
message: The SIM was in a state that cannot send, for example locked or still starting. Unlock the SIM or wait, then send the message again.

name: RIL_NO_SMS_TO_ACK
message: The mobile radio reported an acknowledgement error. Send the message again.

name: RIL_SIM_BUSY
message: The SIM was busy. Wait a moment, then send the message again.

name: RIL_SIM_FULL
message: The storage on the SIM is full. Delete old messages stored on the SIM, then send the message again.

name: RIL_NO_SUBSCRIPTION
message: The phone has no active SIM subscription for this send. Check that the SIM is in the phone and active, or select a different SIM.

name: RIL_NO_NETWORK_FOUND
message: The phone found no mobile network. Move the phone to a place with coverage, then send the message again.

name: RIL_DEVICE_IN_USE
message: The mobile radio was busy with another task. Wait a moment, then send the message again.

name: RIL_ABORTED
message: The mobile radio stopped the send before it finished. Send the message again.

name: SEND_FAILED_AFTER_MAX_RETRY
message: Android tried the send as many times as it allows, and every try failed. Check the signal and the SMS credit on the SIM, then send the message again.

name: PERMISSION_DENIED
message: textbee does not have the SMS permission on the phone. Open the textbee app on the phone and allow the SMS permission, then send the message again.

name: SEND_INTERRUPTED
message: The textbee app stopped after it handed the message to the mobile radio and before the result arrived. The message may have been sent, and the phone does not send it again. Check with the recipient before you send it again.

name: SIM_SLOT_EMPTY
message: The phone has no active SIM in the slot this message asked for. Put a SIM in that slot or choose another SIM, then send the message again.

name: SENDING_EXCEPTION
message: Android stopped the send with an error before it reached the mobile radio, and deviceMessage has the error. Check the recipient number and the selected SIM, then send the message again.

name: DELIVERY_REPORT_CANCELLED
message: The phone sent the SMS, but the carrier sent no delivery report, often because it does not support them. The message can still have arrived.

name: CARRIER_NETWORK_ERROR
message: The carrier could not deliver the SMS because of an error in its network, and it stopped trying. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_INCOMPATIBLE_DESTINATION
message: The carrier could not deliver the SMS because the recipient number cannot receive it, for example a landline. Check the recipient number.

name: CARRIER_REJECTED_BY_RECIPIENT
message: The phone or network of the recipient refused the SMS, and the carrier stopped trying. Check the recipient number.

name: CARRIER_NOT_OBTAINABLE
message: The carrier could not reach the recipient, often because the number does not exist or is not in service. Check the recipient number.

name: CARRIER_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
message: The carrier could not give the SMS the service it needs, and it stopped trying. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_NO_ROUTE
message: The carrier has no route to the network of the recipient. Check the recipient number. You can also send from a SIM on another carrier.

name: CARRIER_EXPIRED
message: The carrier tried to deliver the SMS until it expired, often because the phone of the recipient was off or out of coverage. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_DELETED_BY_SENDER
message: The SMS was deleted at the carrier before delivery, on a request from the sending side. Send the message again.

name: CARRIER_DELETED_BY_CARRIER
message: The carrier deleted the SMS before delivery, often because of a spam filter or a block on the sender. Contact the carrier of the sending SIM.

name: CARRIER_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN
message: The carrier has no record of the SMS, so it could not deliver it. Send the message again.

name: CARRIER_CONGESTION
message: The network of the carrier was too busy to deliver the SMS, and the carrier stopped trying. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_RECIPIENT_BUSY
message: The phone of the recipient was busy, and the carrier stopped trying. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_NO_RESPONSE
message: The phone of the recipient did not answer, often because it was off or out of coverage, and the carrier stopped trying. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_SERVICE_REJECTED
message: The network of the recipient refused the SMS, for example because the number cannot receive SMS or blocks the sender. Check the recipient number.

name: CARRIER_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_TEMPORARY
message: The carrier could not give the SMS the service it needs for a while, and it stopped trying. Send the message again later.

name: CARRIER_RECIPIENT_PHONE_ERROR
message: The phone of the recipient reported an error, for example a full SMS memory, and the carrier stopped trying. Ask the recipient to free space on the phone, then send the message again.

name: CARRIER_DELIVERY_FAILED
message: The carrier sent a delivery report that says the SMS was not delivered, and it stopped trying. The code holds the status value from the carrier.

name: PUSH_TOKEN_NOT_REGISTERED
message: The push service does not know this phone anymore, so the message did not reach it. Open the textbee app on the phone and register it again with the same device id.

name: PUSH_REQUEST_REJECTED
message: The push service rejected the push to this phone, often because the push token of the phone is out of date or the message is very long. Open the textbee app on the phone and register it again with the same device id.

name: PUSH_PROJECT_MISMATCH
message: The phone is registered with a different push project than this server, so the message did not reach it. Open the textbee app on the phone and register it again with the same device id.

name: PUSH_RATE_LIMITED
message: The push service limits how many messages one phone can get in a short time, and this phone reached the limit. Send fewer messages at once, then send the message again.

name: PUSH_FAILED
message: The push service could not deliver the message to the phone. Send the message again, and if it fails again, register the phone again from the textbee app.

name: PUSH_TIMEOUT
message: The push to the phone did not finish in time. The phone can still get the message, so check the message status before you send it again.

name: PUSH_SEND_ERROR
message: textbee could not reach the push service. Send the message again.

name: PUSH_SKIPPED
message: textbee did not push this message to the phone, because pushes are paused for this account or device.

name: DISPATCH_FAILED
message: textbee could not hand the message to the push service. Send the message again.

name: QUEUE_ADD_FAILED
message: textbee could not add the message to the send queue. Send the message again.

name: SEND_TIMEOUT
message: The push to the phone was rejected and the phone did not collect the message in time. The message was not sent. Send it again.
